title: MAPE-K Agentic Fraud Detection System
summary: A multi-agent MAPE-K financial fraud detection and pattern learning system that monitors, scores, and adapts to fraudulent transactions. Its balance agent addresses class imbalance in fraud labels by directly invoking the standalone ctgan package's CTGAN model to synthesize minority-class transaction records.
